## tsa09-p01
And it is sevenfold in sixfold-scripture itself, supremely by the Lord stated. (9.1) Therein — Śivas, great mantra-lords, mantra-lords, mantras, knowledge-bodiless, dissolution-bodiless, with-parts — the seven power-possessors. (9.2) Of them are seven itself powers; through their division, from earth to chief-principle-end, by fourteen divisions, in each own form fifteenth. (9.3) Therein own form is knowability-fit, self-abiding; through lower-goddess grace, in knowers with excessed powers, whatever is rest-receptacle — that is of itself power-form; through upper-lower-goddess grace — and that is sevenfold from power-so-much-ness. (9.4) But in power-possessor-form-primacy, in knower-class, whatever is rested — that is powerful-Śiva-form — through supreme-goddess grace; that too is sevenfold. (9.5) Since of knowers from Śiva to with-parts-end of so many is the stating. (9.6) Therein from power-division alone is of knowers division; and it, for clarifying, is told in with-parts-first-course. Therein: of with-parts-one, in knowledge-art is power — since that-distinction-formed of intellect-action-sense-powers; but of dissolution-bodiless, they themselves, from objectlessness, in unmanifest. (9.7) Of knowledge-bodiless, they themselves, with melted art, with refinement-companion, awakening is pure knowledge of mantra. (9.8) Without that refinement, that itself awakened is of mantra-lord. (9.9) That itself, wanting to seize will-power-formness autonomy-natured, is of great mantra-lord. (9.10) Will-natured, manifest-autonomy-natured, is of Śiva — thus power-divisions seven chief. (9.11) And from their tinge-made is in powerful knowers division — since sense-division ends in agent-division, and through non-different power alone from can-be-made-sense, not of other — from regress-fall. (9.12) But really one alone, in pure autonomy-bliss-resting, is knower. Therein when earth, as nature-only-rested, is known — then nature of it merely shines: "seen by Caitra's eye, known by Caitra" — "I know" thus. Therein by whole-power-made, by whole-powerful-form-made, other-nature shines indeed. Thus to Śiva-end too is to be stated — abiding in Śiva-power, resting in Śiva-nature is the universe — "I know" thus, through being of distinct conviction. (9.13) "But if of thing there is knowableness as own body, then for all there is knowableness; and knowableness too is knowable — thus regress; and through it, of world, blind-asleep-ness, well-shining; and through it, in knowable-unknowable, contrary-nature-yoga — thus is the flaw. Here it is said: (9.14) Not that own body of nature separately stated. What then? That in knower-power and in knower, whatever is rest-receptacle — whatever form — that indeed, that self-shining itself — that shines not toward anything at all — thus is omniscience; and regress-contrary-yoga thus is far removed. (9.15) Even known by endless knowers, one alone is that — of it is the form; in so much, of them from one-shining-form-ness — hence is no other-knower-knowledge-inference-obstacle whatever. And that of it is form true — through doing-work. Thus indeed seeing the beloved seen by other, one envies for her; seeing Śiva-nature rest-jar, one immerses; seeing thing rested in by endless knowers, one becomes full — like dancer-watching. Of that very blue is that form in knower — whatever is rested — thus alone from self-shining-grasping-rise — thus is fifteen-naturedness from earth onward to chief-principle-end. (9.16)"

## tsa09-p01 — seven knowers, and what "knowable" means
The sixfold books say it best: seven. Śivas, great mantra-lords, mantra-lords, mantras, the knowledge-bodied, the dissolution-bodied, the parted — seven power-owners, seven powers, and through their split, from earth to the chief, fourteen cuts apiece with a fifteenth — one's own shape — in each. "Own shape" means: fit to be known, settled in itself. Where knowers run high-powered, whatever they rest in takes power's shape (the Lower goddess's grace, seven ways for seven powers). Where the owners lead, what rests takes Śiva's powerful shape (the Supreme goddess's grace, seven ways too). Knowers divide because powers do — told parted-first so it's clear: the parted one's power sits in art-as-knowledge (mind, act, senses in their distinct shapes); the dissolution-bodied one's same powers sit objectless, dim; the knowledge-bodied's, art melted, ripening with its traces, wakes as mantra's bright knowing; stripped of those traces, as mantra-lords'; reaching to seize will-power, free by nature, as the great mantra-lord's; as bare will, openly free, as Śiva's. Seven chief powers. And knowers tinged by them differ — since senses end in agents, and only undivided power can be sensified (anything else, regress). Really, though, the knower is one, resting in bright free bliss. "Caitra's eye saw it, Caitra knew it, I know it" — earth known as bare nature shines bare; with all powers on, another nature shines — and so up to Śiva: "I know the universe, kept in Śiva's power, resting in Śiva's nature." A distinct conviction every time. "But if knowable means 'its own body,' then everything is knowable to everyone, knowableness is itself knowable, regress — a world brightly asleep and blind, and knowable-unpredictable both at once. Flawed." Answer: no separately-stated "own body." What rests in knower and knower's power — whatever shape — shines by itself, toward nothing: that is omniscience, and regress with contradiction is miles away. Known by endless knowers, it stays one — one shining for all of them — so no other-minds blockage; and its shape is real, because it works. Seeing another's beloved, you burn for her. Seeing Śiva-nature, jar of rest, you dive in. Seeing a thing all endless knowers rest in, you fill — like watching the dancer. Blue's shape in the knower, whatever rests there, rises from self-shining grasping alone — fifteen-natured, from earth to the chief.

## tsa09-p02
"[So much of excess-passion-cover with-parts-one, from knowerhood, of with-parts-one too thus fifteenfold; of it too from so-much knowableness. (9.17) And in detail that is decided in Tantrāloka. (9.18) From person onward to art-principle-end, thirteenfold. (9.19) Of with-parts-one, through knowerhood-yoga, of its power-possessor-self twofold division setting — and thus of with-parts-one nature alone alone is dissolution-bodiless nature in five-knowerhood eleven divisions. (9.20) Of knowledge-bodiless nature in four-knowerhood, nine divisions. (9.21) Of mantra nature in three-knowerhood, seven. (9.22) Of mantra-lord nature in two-knowerhood, five. (9.23) Of great-mantra-lord nature in Lord alone knowerhood, from power-possessor-division, three. (9.24) But of Śiva, light-only-pure-autonomy-full, no division at all, from fullness. (9.25) Thus this principle-division alone, in Lord-unsurpassed-course-one-named, described, makes world-difference-variety — of hell-heaven-Rudra-worlds, in earthhood same though far nature-difference stated. (9.26) Herein, curious by mutual-division-grasping for sub-division-knowledge, one should heed Tantrāloka itself. (9.27) Thus pot-by-pot-following too, of earth-and-rest principles, division is described. (9.28) Now whole earth-principle as knower-known-aimed is described: whose shining undifferentiated by earth-principle — he is Śiva. (9.29) As the heard texts: 'Earth indeed is this Brahman.' (9.30) Impelling earth-principle-success-giving is that earth-great-mantra-lord; to be impelled is earth-mantra-lord; of it the speaker, ego-image-bodied, is mantra — practiced-earth-yoga past-Sāṅkhya-bestial-knowledge, unreached-firm-state, earth-knowledge-bodiless. (9.31) By bestial-knowledge-course, practiced-earth-yoga, at end or death, earth-dissolution-bodiless. (9.32) For in sleep, through tattva-entry-force alone, of variegated dreams is rise; but grasped-earth-conceit is earth-with-parts. (9.33) Here too, through power-excess-decline, fourteenfold — thus of knower-become earthhood... (9.34–9.35, positions per T1.)]"

## tsa09-p02 — counting down, and earth's whole ladder (CONDENSED companion)
The parted one, passion-covered, is fifteen ways too — knowable just so far. (Tantrāloka spells it out.) From person to art: thirteen. Then the countdown as knowerhoods set: with-parts nature alone — thirteen for the parted's nature; dissolution-bodied nature in five knowerhoods — eleven; knowledge-bodied in four — nine; mantra in three — seven; mantra-lord in two — five; great-mantra-lord with the Lord alone knowing — three, owner-or-owned; Śiva, sheer light-free-full — none, being full. Principle-splitting under the one uns surpassed-Lord course is what varies the worlds — hells, heavens, Rudra-worlds on the same earth, far apart in nature. For the sub-splits, be curious in the Tantrāloka. Pot by pot works the same. Now earth whole, as knower-and-known: earth's shining undifferentiated is Śiva ("earth is Brahman indeed," say the texts). Earth's great-mantra-lord drives, giving earth's wins; earth's mantra-lord is driven; its mouthpiece, ego-bodied mantra, with earth-yoga past beast-knowledge of Sāṅkhya and the rest, short of the firm station — earth's knowledge-bodiless. By beast-knowledge course with earth-yoga practised, at life's end or death — earth's dissolution-bodied. In sleep, tattva-entry alone raises motley dreams; earth-conceit grasped is earth-with-parts. Power's wax and wane make fourteen here too...

l1_text:
## tsa09-p03
"[One's-own-work-doership is grasper-natured — so stated; it is not counted again — thus discrimination-rich, teacher-dwelling-following, everywhere fifteenfold by division one discriminates. (9.36) But in thought-lessness there is instant-lessness — as in joy-consciousnesses, until thought-free alone. (9.37) But folk, by thought-rest, mistake that I-ness-formed, I-ness-covered-this-ness-spread thought-free grasping-ground unmanifest as suffering-state — as joy-rested mistake; but by thought-waning it shines indeed — thus this carefulness in grasper-grasped relation — so the Abhinavagupta teachers. (9.38) And thus fifteenfold standing: as far as manifest-I-natured difference lessens, pairs wane in twos, until two-instant Śiva-immersion: therein the first instant all-full, the second all-knowledge-sense-entered-practiced, fitting for omniscience-omnipotence — not the first. (9.39) As venerable Kallata said: 'instant-fall' — here fall-word is goddess Kālī herself, Mother-of-Beings, Bhairava, intuitiveness — enough of secret-nonself. (9.40) Thus from mantra-great-lord-instant onward, through practice thereof, thereof siddhis. (9.41) Now herein waking-and-rest-states are described: therein, of knowable and its consciousness, whatever variety mutually dependent — that is state — not of knowable alone, nor of consciousness alone, nor two separate. (9.42) Therein, when shining as to-be-supported, as outer-formed, then waking state — in known, measurer, measure. (9.43) But when therein, as supporting-formed, shining is resolve — then dream state. (9.44) But when therein, as supporter-formed, as seed-natured alone shining — then deep-sleep state. (9.45) These three alone, as known-means-knower-states, each fourfold by waking-and-the-rest, are stated. (9.46) But when therein, in knower-rest-gone, through knower's fullness-facing, shining as fullness-facing — then fourth state. And it is 'form, I see' — thus crossing three parts 'I see' — means-less knowerhood, autonomy-essence, by near-middle-far, conferring knower-means-known baptism, gracing the three states, threefold. (9.47–9.53 per T1.)]"

## tsa09-p03 — fifteen everywhere, the instant, and the four states (CONDENSED companion)
Doing one's own work is being a grasper — said, not recounted — so the rich-in-discernment, dwelling with teachers, tell fifteen everywhere by dividing. Fewer thoughts, fewer instants — down, in joys and knowings, to thought-free. People rest in thought and mistake the I-shaped, I-covered, this-spreading, thought-free grasping-ground, unshown, for suffering — as the joy-rested mistake pain; but as thought thins it shines — careful, then, with grasper and grasped, say my teachers. Fifteen standing: as I-natured difference thins, pairs thin two by two, till Śiva-immersion of two instants — first all-full, second entering every knowing-sense, practised, fit for all-knowing, all-doing (not the first). Kallata's "instant-fall": fall is goddess Kālī herself, the Mother of Beings, Bhairava, intuitiveness — secrets and non-secrets enough. From mantra-lord's instant on, practice brings the wins. Now waking and the rest: knowable and its knowing, whatever variety they hold together — that is a state (not the known alone, not knowing alone, not two apart). Shining as supported, outer-shaped: waking — in known, measurer, measure. Shining as supporting shape: resolve — dream. Shining as supporter, seed-natured alone: deep sleep. These three, as known-means-knower states, each in waking shapes four ways. But shining, in gone-to-knower-rest, as fullness-facing through the knower's facing-fullness: the fourth — "form — I see" — crossing "I see"'s three parts, knowerhood without means, autonomy-pith, near, middle, far, baptizing knower-means-known, gracing the three states, threefold...

Doing one's own work is being a grasper — said, not recounted — so the rich-in-discernment, dwelling with teachers, tell fifteen everywhere by dividing. Fewer thoughts, fewer instants — down, in joys and knowings, to thought-free. People rest in thought and mistake the I-shaped, I-covered, this-spreading, thought-free grasping-ground, unshown, for suffering — as the joy-rested mistake pain; but as thought thins it shines — careful, then, with grasper and grasped, say my teachers. Fifteen standing: as I-natured difference thins, pairs thin two by two, till Śiva-immersion of two instants — first all-full, second all-knowing-sense-entered-practiced for omniscience-omnipotence (not the first). Kallata: "instant-fall" — fall-word = goddess Kālī herself, the Mother of Beings, Bhairava, intuitiveness; enough of secret-nonself. From mantra-lord's instant on, practice brings the wins. Now waking and the rest: knowable and its knowing, whatever variety they hold together — that is a state (not the known alone, not knowing alone, not two apart). Shining as supported, outer-shaped: waking — in known, measurer, measure. Shining as supporting shape: resolve — dream. Shining as supporter, seed-natured alone: deep sleep. These three, as known-means-knower states, each in waking shapes four ways. But shining, in gone-to-knower-rest, as fullness-facing through the knower's facing-fullness: the fourth — "form, I see" — crossing "I see"'s three parts, knowerhood without means, autonomy-essence, near, middle, far, baptizing knower-means-known, gracing the three states, threefold.

The passage moves in seven steps. (1) Doing one's own work = being a grasper (said, not recounted); rich-in-discernment dwelling with teachers tell fifteen everywhere by dividing. (2) Fewer thoughts → fewer instants → thought-free. (3) Folk mistake the thought-free grasping-ground (unshown) for suffering (joy-rested mistake); as thought thins it shines — careful with grasper-grasped. (4) Fifteen standing: I-natured difference thins, pairs thin two by two, till two-instant Śiva-immersion (first all-full, second all-knowing-sense-practiced for omniscience/omnipotence). (5) Kallata's "instant-fall" = Kālī/Bhairava/intuitiveness. (6) From mantra-lord's instant, practice brings wins. (7) Four states: waking (supported, outer-shaped, in known/measurer/measure), dream (supporting shape = resolve), deep sleep (supporter, seed-natured), fourth (fullness-facing, crossing three parts "I see," means-less knowerhood, autonomy-essence, near/middle/far, baptizing the triad, gracing the three states, threefold).
